segments.name: Online platform services
segments.description: Runs one online platform business in mainland China, selling dealer subscription services and other services delivered as software products to its users.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized and managed as one segment based on the nature and financial effects of the business activities.

revenueModel.text: Dealers and platform users pay for subscription and other services that the company sells in the form of software products.
revenueModel.evidence: they are subject to 13 % VAT for the dealer subscription services and other services, which were sold in the form of software products.
